item.title: Write a week of salon captions that get bookings
item.description:
Today's prompt turns photos of your own work into a week of Instagram captions, each ending with a clear way to book.

DO THIS TODAY: Turn photos of your own work into a week of Instagram captions that ask for a booking

Setup: about 20 minutes · Saves: most of the writing time on each post (rough estimate)

  1. Pick 5 photos or videos of your own work from the last few weeks. Use client photos only if the client agreed.
  2. For each one, jot down the service, what you did, one detail a client would notice and who it suits.
  3. Paste your notes, your booking method and any real openings into the prompt below.
  4. Edit each caption into your own voice and check every service name, price and opening against your booking app.
  5. Post one a day and note which ones bring booking messages.

Copy-paste prompt:

I run a [salon/barbershop/nail or lash studio] in [town]. Write Instagram captions for these posts of my own work. Use only the details I give; don't invent services, prices, results, openings or client stories.
How clients book: [link in bio / booking app / DM / phone]
Openings this week (or 'none'): [days and times]
Our voice: [3 words]
Posts:
1) [service] - [what I did] - [one detail a client would notice] - [who it suits]
2) ...

For each post write: a short first line that names the result or the service, 2-3 short sentences, one call to book that matches how clients book, and up to 5 hashtags that name the service and [town]. No client names. No promises about results. If a detail is missing, ask me instead of guessing.

Privacy: Leave out client names, phone numbers, photos you don't have permission to share and anything about a client's health, skin or scalp conditions.

Example output (illustrative, not real data):

Example captions for Example Hair Studio

PostFirst lineCall to book
Balayage refreshSoft, sunny blonde that grows out without a hard line.Two Thursday spots left; book through the link in our bio.
Men's fadeClean skin fade with a textured top for the week ahead.Book your next cut through the link in our bio.
Gel manicureShort, glossy nails in a fall shade.DM us 'nails' and we'll send open times.

So what: If you try it on your shop's Instagram, read every caption before you approve it, the same check as today's task.
